long: Cryostasis: Sleep of Reason is a first-person survival horror game set aboard a Soviet nuclear icebreaker frozen in the Arctic. The player must manage body heat against the lethal cold while exploring the ship, and can use a Mental Echo ability to enter the memories of the dead and alter past events. It is a single-player narrative experience known for its oppressive atmosphere and PhysX-driven ice effects.
